symbols.reasoning: Validates name/product and positive quantities, forbids an active empty recipe, loads actor and optional approver, and authorizes menu_manage before beginning a transaction. Stable recipe ID supports equivalent resulting contents, not immutable request replay: changed payload with same ID is accepted, line integer IDs are regenerated. Existing items are removed and new items inserted with product backlink in one Save/Commit. Concurrency has no version check: last metadata update/competing replace can conflict or lose edits. On retarget, previous Product.RecipeId is not cleared, while new product is pointed at this recipe; this is a configuration consistency lead requiring policy/client verification, not a counted financial loss. Kind/yield validation is documented by request but absent here; FK handles missing item/product, not semantic yield validity. Cancellation before commit rolls back through disposal; response-loss after commit retry replaces contents, no stock or treasury posting.
